svg.aria-label: A curved line for the visible service, with an experiment above it. Its line reaches down through the surface and hooks a thread of interpretation, lifting it. Beneath lie threads of operations, relationships, decision rights and legislation, tied to each other by short stitches, so the threads below come up too. They show most clearly around the place it pulled.
svg.title: An experiment reaches beneath the surface of a service and lifts one thread of the materials underneath, bringing the threads tied to it into view
